description: This file contains the implementation of the ProgramWorkflowService interface for managing programs, workflows, states, and related entities in the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation, state transitions, and retrieval of program and workflow data.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the ProgramWorkflowService interface that provides business logic for managing programs, workflows, states, and related entities within OpenMRS. It handles CRUD operations, validations, transitions, and retrievals.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object for program workflow operations.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Validates and saves a Program entity, including its workflows and states.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its ID.

methods.name: getProgramByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its unique name, handling duplicate names.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves all programs, with optional inclusion of retired programs.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Deletes a Program, with optional cascade for related entities.

methods.name: retireProgram
methods.description: Marks a Program and its components as retired.

methods.name: unretireProgram
methods.description: Reverses the retirement of a Program and its components.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Validates and saves a PatientProgram, ensuring states and dates are consistent.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by its ID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves PatientPrograms based on various filters.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram, with cascade option.

methods.name: voidPatientProgram
methods.description: Voids a PatientProgram and records the reason.

methods.name: unvoidPatientProgram
methods.description: Reverses voiding of a PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Retrieves possible outcome concepts for a program.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves a ConceptStateConversion entity after validation.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by ID.

methods.name: getAllConceptStateConversions
methods.description: Retrieves all ConceptStateConversions.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion for a specific workflow and concept.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves programs associated with a given concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves workflows associated with a given concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Retrieves workflow states associated with a given concept.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by UUID.

methods.name: getProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by UUID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by its ID.

methods.name: getStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientState by UUID.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by UUID.

methods.name: getAllProgramAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute types for programs.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a ProgramAttributeType entity.

methods.name: purgeProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgramAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByAttributeName
methods.description: Retrieves a map of PatientProgramAttributes by attribute name for given patients.
